criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect all final exact views. All generated concept panels inspected. Preserve naked branching hierarchy but correct thick tree-like trunk and pronounced modern roots to slender axis/minimal conjectural base. Concept uses too few branches and sparse fertile bunches; freeze16 successive four-rank lateral systems, ten dense terminal clusters and six sterile sprays. Do not copy apparent equal-height pairs in concept.

Dominant slender upright tapering pseudomonopodial main axis, 16 successively ascending complex laterals arranged in four ranks, not same-height spoke whorls. Each lateral repeatedly dichotomizes with shorter distal intervals; ten fertile laterals carry dense clusters of elongate terminal sporangia, six sterile laterals terminate in naked forks. Whole reconstructed exterior including a minimal conjectural basal connection; no broad leaves, fern fronds, flowers, cones or modern woody trunk. Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for P.quadrifaria. Official Maine Geological Survey specimen photograph and separate artist reconstruction support gross axial hierarchy, four ranks spiraling along axis, fertile clusters and sterile branching. Complete proportions, count, one-meter art height, basal anchorage and color are artistic, not measured fossil facts. Original architecture-level uncertainty retained; primary1972 publisher full text/plates unavailable403, not claimed inspected. Devonian refers to Trout Valley source context, not exhaustive range.
